description: Write UGC (creator-style) video ad scripts that sound like a person, not an ad. Picks a format beyond the overused testimonial, sizes the script to the video length by words per second, structures it beat by beat (hook, problem, demo, proof, ask), and writes it so it works with the sound off and when an AI video model or voice reads it.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
